text: Enterprise SSO UX for review: admin pastes KeyGate metadata URL → we validate → 'test login' button → enforce SSO toggle. Fallback: owner keeps a break-glass password login.
Make the validation errors human. 'Signing cert invalid' should say what to do next.
Ironically that exact error is what ATL-212 is stuck on: KeyGate's metadata endpoint serves a stale cert after rotation. Devon's waiting on them.
Globex's IT team will be the first to use this flow, so it needs to be bulletproof.
Adding a 'retry metadata fetch' action and a copyable error id for support.
